Consequence: logout state updates may not flush, so the post-1000ms storage/store assertions can read stale values or emit act warnings. Consequence: if that argument anchors issuance/expiry (or is required), the mock refresh token is malformed and all five boundary cases exercise the wrong expiry behavior.
